name: BlitB3
description: Band-limited impulse generator based on B-spline interpolation of order 3. Produces a clean impulse train suitable for integration into saw/square/triangle waveforms. From sc3-plugins AntiAliasingOscillators (Nam, Valimaki, Abel, Smith 2010).

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Frequency in Hertz. Maximum is sampling rate / 4 (period of 4 samples)

name: BlitB3Saw
description: BLIT-derived sawtooth waveform. Band-limited impulse generator (B-spline order 3) integrated to produce a sawtooth. Perceptually indistinguishable from analogue saw up to ~5kHz. From sc3-plugins AntiAliasingOscillators.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Frequency in Hertz. Maximum is sampling rate / 4

inputs.name: leak
inputs.description: Leaky integrator coefficient. 0 returns the impulse train; values approaching 1.0 fill the inter-impulse space producing a smooth saw

name: BlitB3Square
description: Bipolar BLIT-derived square waveform. Band-limited impulse generator (B-spline order 3) alternating polarity and integrated to produce a square wave. From sc3-plugins AntiAliasingOscillators.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Frequency in Hertz. Frequency only updates at the close of each period

inputs.name: leak
inputs.description: Leaky integrator coefficient. 0 returns the impulse train; values approaching 1.0 produce a smooth square

name: BlitB3Tri
description: Bipolar BLIT-derived triangle waveform. Band-limited impulse generator (B-spline order 3) doubly integrated to produce a triangle. Richer than LFTri but less efficient. From sc3-plugins AntiAliasingOscillators.

name: DPW3Tri
description: Triangle waveform generated via a 3rd-order differentiated polynomial waveform. Very clean above 200 Hz; some distortion creeps in for lower frequencies. From sc3-plugins AntiAliasingOscillators.

name: DPW4Saw
description: Sawtooth waveform generated via a 4th-order differentiated polynomial waveform. Internally uses DPW2 below 400 Hz with a crossfade to DPW4 in the 400-600 Hz region (Valimaki, Nam, Smith, Abel 2010). From sc3-plugins AntiAliasingOscillators.
